description: This PHP source file defines the AdminSdgEditForm class, which extends AbstractFormProcessor to handle form creation and saving for editing SDG (Sustainable Development Goals) categories within an admin interface. It includes form fields for name, description, icon, and associated footprints, and manages validation, image processing, and data persistence.

classes.name: AdminSdgEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing SDG categories in the admin panel, handling form creation, validation, image processing, and data saving.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for the form, specifically a NotBlank constraint.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for name, description, icon, and footprints, populating choices from Footprint::getList.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data, processes image changes, updates the model, and handles errors.
